# Simulation lineage

## Design

- NVIDIA sample outputs are stored as `SAMPLE_SIMULATION_OUTPUT`,
  `SAMPLE_CFD_OUTPUT` and `SAMPLE_ELECTRICAL_OUTPUT` records, kept **separate**
  from AURA runs, and labelled
  "NVIDIA DSX sample output - not generated by AURA and not measured".
- AURA runs remain durable server-side `simulation_runs` records (the durable
  run remediation is preserved untouched) and must additionally carry the
  reference dataset id, source configuration, inputs, AURA execution origin,
  solver/model and result provenance.

## Status

- NVIDIA sample outputs: **0 records**. They live only inside the NGC v2.1
  dataset, which returned HTTP 401. No sample simulation output exists in AURA
  and none was fabricated.
- Source-backed scenario definitions **are** available from `options.ts` and are
  normalized as `REFERENCE_SCENARIO`:
  - thermal: zones Data Hall, Exterior; operations Normal, Emergency; variables
    Temperature (25-45 C), Velocity (fps), Pressure (Pa)
  - electrical: zones GPU Rack, Main substation, 345kV Main Sub 1-4, CDU (GPU);
    operations Normal, Loss of 1 utility, Loss of 1 gas turbine-single generator
    failure; variables Voltage kV, Current kA, P MW, Q MVAr, Power Factor %,
    THDi %, THDv %, Availability %
- Wiring of Simulation Studio to these definitions: **not executed**.
- No simulation formula was changed.
